mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ra_ai_analysis_run WHERE expires_at_ms <= #{now} ORDER BY expires_at_ms,id LIMIT 1000
mapper.select: SELECT id,owner_doctor_id AS ownerDoctorId,scope_fingerprint AS scopeFingerprint,sort_key AS sortKey,payload_version AS payloadVersion,payload,payload_sha256 AS payloadSha256,created_at_ms AS createdAtMs,expires_at_ms AS expiresAtMs FROM ra_ai_analysis_run WHERE id=#{id}
